description.value: As a living hologram, you're both a construct and a living creature. You don't have the typical construct immunities, can be affected by effects that target a living creature, heal naturally with rest, and can recover Hit Points normally via vitality energy. You can regain Hit Points through @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Treat Wounds] and Repair. You aren't destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points. Instead, you're knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Unconscious] and begin dying when reduced to 0 Hit Points.
